title: Oxidative Stress Amelioration of Novel Peptides Extracted from Enzymatic Hydrolysates of Chinese Pecan Cake.
authors: Zhang, Jiaojiao; Wu, Shaozhen; Wang, Qingqing; Yuan, Qinjie; Li, Yane; Reboredo-Rodriguez, Patricia; Varela-Lopez, Alfonso; He, Zhiping; Wu, Fenghua; Hu, Hao; Liu, Xingquan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究山核桃蛋白水解肽的抗氧化活性及与Keap1的分子对接，虽涉及转录因子Keap1的对接，但核心是肽段抗氧化功能而非TF-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Pecan (Carya cathayensis) is an important economic crop, and its hydrolyzed peptides have been evidenced to reduce the effect of oxidative stress due to their antioxidant capacity. Hence, the protocols of ultrafiltration and gel filtration chromatography were established to obtain bioactive peptides from by-products of C. cathayensis (pecan cake). As measured by DPPH/ABTS radical scavenging, the peptides with less molecular weight (MW) possess higher antioxidant capacity. PCPH-III (MW < 3 kDa) presented higher radical scavenging capacity than PCPH-II (3 kDa < MW < 10 kDa) and PCPH-I (MW > 10 kDa) measured by DPPH (IC50: 111.0 mug/ mL) and measured by ABTs (IC50: 402.9 mug/mL). The secondary structure and amino acid composition varied by their MW, in which PCPH-II contained more alpha-helices (26.71%) and beta-sheets (36.96%), PCPH-III contained higher ratios of beta-turns (36.87%), while the composition of different secondary of PCPH-I was even 25 +/- 5.76%. The variation trend of alpha-helix and random experienced slightly varied from PCPH-I to PCPH-II, while significantly decreased from PCPH-II to PCPH-III. The increasing antioxidant capacity is followed by the content of proline, and PCPH-III had the highest composition (8.03%). With regard to the six peptides identified by LC-MS/MS, two of them (VYGYADK and VLFSNY) showed stronger antioxidant capacity than others. In silico molecular docking demonstrated their combining abilities with a transcription factor Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1) and speculated that they inhibit oxidative stress through activating the Keap1-Nrf2-ARE pathway. Meanwhile, increased activity of SOD and CAT-antioxidant markers-were found in H2O2-induced cells. The residue of tyrosine was demonstrated to contribute the most antioxidant capacity of VYGYADK and its position affected less. This study provided a novel peptide screening and by-product utilization process that can be applied in natural product developments.
abstract_zh: 碧根果（Carya cathayensis）是一种重要的经济作物，其水解肽已被证明因其抗氧化能力而能减轻氧化应激的影响。因此，建立了超滤和凝胶过滤色谱法，从碧根果副产物（碧根果饼）中获取生物活性肽。通过DPPH/ABTS自由基清除测定，分子量（MW）较小的肽具有更高的抗氧化能力。PCPH-III（MW < 3 kDa）在DPPH（IC50：111.0 μg/mL）和ABTS（IC50：402.9 μg/mL）测定中表现出比PCPH-II（3 kDa < MW < 10 kDa）和PCPH-I（MW > 10 kDa）更高的自由基清除能力。其二级结构和氨基酸组成随分子量变化而异，其中PCPH-II含有更多的α-螺旋（26.71%）和β-折叠（36.96%），PCPH-III含有较高比例的β-转角（36.87%），而PCPH-I的不同二级结构组成则均匀为25 ± 5.76%。从PCPH-I到PCPH-II，α-螺旋和无规卷曲的变化趋势略有差异，而从PCPH-II到PCPH-III则显著下降。抗氧化能力的增强与脯氨酸含量相关，PCPH-III具有最高组成（8.03%）。关于通过LC-MS/MS鉴定的六种肽，其中两种（VYGYADK和VLFSNY）表现出比其他肽更强的抗氧化能力。计算机模拟分子对接（in silico molecular docking）证明了它们与转录因子Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）的结合能力，并推测它们通过激活Keap1-Nrf2-ARE通路来抑制氧化应激。同时，在H2O2诱导的细胞中，发现SOD和CAT（抗氧化标志物）的活性增加。酪氨酸残基被证明对VYGYADK的抗氧化能力贡献最大，而其位置影响较小。本研究提供了一种新颖的肽筛选和副产物利用工艺，可应用于天然产物开发。
